key: The other side of the train tracks is notorious for gang activity and homeless persons.
en: The other side of the train tracks is notorious for gang activity and homeless persons.
ja: 線路の向こう側は　不良の集まりや　家のない人たちで　悪名高いの

key: Not only in case we're attacked, but what if my son grows up to be like them?
en: Not only in case we're attacked, but what if my son grows up to be like them?
ja: おそわれるかもしれないだけじゃなく　息子が　あんなふうに育ったら　どうしよう

key: I used to be afraid that my kid would grow up and get into trouble, but seeing how he lights up when advertising the city restoration...
en: I used to be afraid that my kid would grow up and get into trouble, but seeing how he lights up when advertising the city restoration...
ja: 息子が　悪い道に進むんじゃないかと　こわかったけど　街の復興を宣伝するときの　あの明るい顔を見ると……

key: I somehow get the feeling that whatever choices he makes, he'll be just fine.
en: I somehow get the feeling that whatever choices he makes, he'll be just fine.
ja: どんな道を選んでも　この子なら大丈夫だと　思えてくるの
